nodes.label: App redesign v1 (visual spec)
nodes.rationale: Redesign of screens still in iOS default style using the fixed palette (60 white / 30 Ink / 10 accent); Duolingo principles in practice (depth-edge buttons, clear colour feedback), Brilliant-like calm outside practice.

nodes.label: Ink ramp (30%)
nodes.rationale: Neutral ramp ink50-ink950

nodes.label: Blue ramp (accent)
nodes.rationale: Accent / interactive

nodes.label: Green ramp (correct)
nodes.rationale: Correct feedback only

nodes.label: Coral ramp (wrong)
nodes.rationale: Wrong feedback / destructive

nodes.label: Sun ramp (reward)
nodes.rationale: Reward: LP, trophy, top rank

nodes.label: 60/30/10 colour rule (white/Ink/accent)
nodes.rationale: Fixed palette split: 60 white, 30 Ink, 10 accent.

nodes.label: Practice buttons with depth edge
nodes.rationale: 50pt capsule; Check/Continue are Ink (Ink 800 face, Ink 950 edge); Green/Coral only inside the right/wrong feedback panel.

nodes.label: Product-area buttons (Ink primary, flat outline, flat destructive)
nodes.rationale: Ink button has a depth edge like Blue; outline and delete buttons are flat and shrink to 97% on press; actions that start practice use Blue.

nodes.label: Native iOS controls kept (Toggle, Segmented, DatePicker, tab bar, nav bar, sheet, Menu)
nodes.rationale: System components keep their original rendering; only the tint follows the palette.

nodes.label: Syll custom controls (word-count stepper, weekday picker)
nodes.rationale: iOS has no suitable equivalent.

nodes.label: Card rule: white, 2pt Ink 200 border, radius 20, no shadow; 1.5pt Ink 100 row dividers
Sub-page header: back button only, large title in content
nodes.rationale: iOS 26 draws the back button as a Liquid Glass circle; one title per screen.

nodes.label: Dialogs use ConfirmSheet instead of .alert; no swipe actions/context menus (⋯ opens action sheet)
nodes.rationale: Never draw a custom centred popup; always Cancel + Confirm.

nodes.label: Sound controls: inline speaker and centre speaker/mic
nodes.source_location: Nút âm thanh · loa và micro
nodes.rationale: Inline: Blue 50 disc, Blue 600 icon, 44pt tap area, waves 1→2→3 every 280ms while playing. Centre: 128pt Blue 500 face, 5pt Blue 700 edge, no halo at rest; recording shows ■ stop and a voice-driven Blue 100/50 halo. Reduce Motion freezes.

nodes.label: Answer tiles with depth edge (rest/selected/correct/wrong/off)
nodes.rationale: Text centred, one weight in every state to avoid text jumping; correctness shown by colour only, no ✓/✕.

nodes.label: Bottom feedback panel with Syllie (answer/ok/wrong/reveal/exhausted)
nodes.rationale: Exhausted / revealed uses Blue 50 info panel (not red); wrong-with-tries uses Coral 50 with Try again.

nodes.label: Flow 0 · Sign in & sign up
nodes.rationale: First screen when signed out; one main action per screen; first sign-in goes to Onboarding; app language follows device, no language screen.

nodes.label: Flow 0b · Onboarding
nodes.rationale: Welcome → Level (optional placement test) → Collection → Topics → Routine → Ready; one question per screen.

nodes.label: Flow 1 · Today's lesson (daily session)
nodes.rationale: Home → review preview → review tasks → review finished → new words → celebration → summary.

nodes.label: Syllie celebration variants
nodes.rationale: Old Rive celebration was too light and identical every time; five random variants (never repeating the last) plus a perfect beat.

nodes.label: Task templates
nodes.rationale: Seven backend templates share one scaffold: question, prompt (centred text or speaker), content, bottom panel with Syllie.

nodes.label: Flow 3 · Add word
nodes.rationale: Whole flow inside one sheet with steps pushed inside it, instead of stacking up to three sheets.

nodes.label: Flow 4 · Profile & settings
nodes.rationale: Brilliant-inspired calm, lots of whitespace.

nodes.label: Flow 5 · Ranking
nodes.rationale: Player report moves from long-press to a ⋯ button (not drawn yet).

nodes.label: 0.1 Login screen
nodes.rationale: Syllie + 'Syll' wordmark; labels above fields; Ink login button; native Apple button, outline Google; errors inline in Coral, no alert.

nodes.label: 0.3 Sign up screen
nodes.rationale: Live password rules (8+ chars, a letter, a digit, max 72); button disabled until met.

nodes.label: 0.5–0.6 Password reset (email, then code)
nodes.rationale: Each step is a sub-page with back button; code field monospaced with iOS autofill; same password rules.

nodes.label: 0b.2 Welcome (Syllie intro)
nodes.rationale: Syllie replaces old F·L·O·W tiles; 'Flow' is no longer the brand.

nodes.label: 0b.3 English level picker (A1–C2)
nodes.rationale: Placement test card on top so unsure learners see it first; shared 4-segment header without 'Step 1/4' text.

nodes.label: 0b.3a–b Placement test & result
nodes.rationale: Practice area; no right/wrong panel because the backend scores at the end; 'Skip' hint discourages guessing which would over-place the learner.

nodes.label: 0b.6 Routine (stepper, days, reminder, daily speaking toggle)
nodes.rationale: No time estimate: no data behind it. Speaking toggle off by default; ⓘ says right/wrong does not affect progress.

nodes.label: 0b.7 Plan ready
nodes.rationale: Blue 'Learn first lesson' opens the first session directly.

nodes.label: 1.1 Home
nodes.rationale: No greeting/wordmark; Syllie + LP pill only; Daily Lesson card shows only next session counts (no time estimate, backend doesn't estimate); 'Extra review' row only when backlog > ReviewLoad.statusThreshold; 'Learning' block with collection/topic progress in collection mark colour, Green when finished.

nodes.label: 1.1a Home · collection finished
nodes.rationale: State shown directly, not hidden in ⓘ; Blue 'Review N words' or 'Practice'; outline 'Choose another collection'.

nodes.label: 1.3–1.7 Select task (text and listening), correct/wrong/exhausted states
nodes.rationale: Listening prompt uses the same 128pt centre control as the mic; no autoplay.

nodes.label: 1.8 Review finished
nodes.rationale: Topic line only when next words come from 1–2 topics; never lists the whole Focus.

nodes.label: 1.10 Word intro (known check, 'I know this word')
nodes.rationale: Daily always has the known check so 'I know this word' always shows (plain ink text button); part of speech belongs to the word; definition behind 'See details'; 'Other meanings' outside the card.

nodes.label: 1.10a Other meanings sheet
nodes.rationale: Reference only, not part of the lesson; does not change session progress.

nodes.label: 1.11 Leave session sheet
nodes.rationale: System sheet with detent instead of .alert; progress only counts when the whole session is finished.

nodes.label: 1.12 Session celebration
nodes.rationale: End of session split in two beats: celebration first, numbers after. Celebrates finishing, independent of correctness; calm copy, celebration lives in motion/sound/haptics; copy appears on Rive 'land' event.

nodes.label: 1.12b Summary (result tiles)
nodes.rationale: Tiles carry no own link because every tile opens the same sheet; one 'See session details ›' row says so once. No Skill tile.

nodes.label: 1.12c Summary · collection finished
nodes.rationale: 'Next with Everyday' card replaces 'Done' so the screen keeps one main action.

nodes.label: 1.13 Session details sheet
nodes.rationale: Each block has a 3-level proportion bar (Blue 600 / Blue 300 / stripe) keyed by group swatches; strong groups collapsed.

nodes.label: 1.13a Session details · Speaking block
nodes.rationale: Passed/not-passed groups with score + band; uses speaking.groups (FRONTEND_FLOW §15.3b), falls back for older backends; speaking never affects word progress.

nodes.label: Celebration variants V1–V5 (puff, fireworks, flip, loop, bounce)
nodes.rationale: Random each session, never repeating the last; each starts and ends in the full rest pose.

nodes.label: Perfect beat (V+): Ink crown
nodes.rationale: Crown is Ink not Sun: Sun is reserved for the collection trophy; trophy wins when both apply.

nodes.label: CelebrateV2 Rive artboard (syllie.riv)
nodes.rationale: Spec frames play the real artboard via Rive web runtime; view model: enum variant, enum kind (session/collection), bool perfect, trigger play.

nodes.label: Syllie mascot usage
nodes.rationale: Syllie replaces spinners, brand tiles and checkmarks (loading, welcome, add-word done, check email) and sits in the practice feedback panel.

nodes.label: T4 Reorder letters
nodes.rationale: Tiles 54×54, narrow for long words to stay on one line.

nodes.label: T5 Match pairs
nodes.rationale: No Check button; panel counts matched pairs.

nodes.label: T6 Spelling surgery
nodes.rationale: Keys 46pt high, 20pt text, close to iOS keyboard.

nodes.label: T7 Read aloud (recording)
nodes.rationale: IPA under the word; ■ stop (not pause) because tapping ends the take.

nodes.label: T7b Scored read-aloud (scoring, result, error)
nodes.rationale: Score ring (176pt) replaces the mic; band title (Excellent!/Good job/Almost there/Keep practicing); syllables coloured good Green 700 / poor Coral 600; detail expands in place; scoring failure uses info panel because it is not the learner's fault.

nodes.label: 2.1 My Words
nodes.rationale: Stats card hierarchy: learned is the main number, weak & fluent are subsets; Weak Words and Speaking Practice start immediately (two equal tiles); Random Practice opens a source picker.

nodes.label: 2.2 Word detail sheet (incl. heteronyms 2.2a)
nodes.rationale: IPA and audio belong to a meaning; shown once under the word only when all meanings sound the same. No skills grid.

nodes.label: 2.3–2.4 Random practice (word source picker)
nodes.rationale: Sources on the screen itself, no sheet; no skill selection anymore.

nodes.label: 2.5–2.6 Added words list, actions sheet, delete confirm
nodes.rationale: ⋯ opens native Menu or action sheet; no swipe actions.

nodes.label: 3.1–3.7 Add word single sheet (entry, loading, multi-sense result, edit, invalid)
nodes.rationale: Multiple senses selectable at once; POST /custom-words per sense, retry only failed ones; example must contain the word.

nodes.label: 4.1 Profile
nodes.rationale: Tier, LP and progress in one card; routine card includes Speaking and auto-balance toggles; review pauses per collection.

nodes.label: 4.3 Settings
nodes.rationale: Removed 'Appearance · Light'; Syllie animations moved into Practice Lab.

nodes.label: 5.1 Weekly ranking
nodes.rationale: Native segmented control; top rank number in Sun; own row Blue 50.

hyperedges.label: Daily session flow: preview → tasks → celebration → summary → details
Task templates sharing the scaffold (question, prompt, content, Syllie panel)
